thread:
maya: Starting a 'SI surge' fast-lane for HW + marketplace integrations next month. Aim: pair 10 SIs with partner HW + listing walkthroughs in two 3-day waves. Need owners for: infra pairing slots, curriculum sprint, voucher automation, and partner shadow hours. Who volunteers?

jon: I can own infra pairing + slot booking. Proposal: 6 H100 seats + 4 Arm instances per wave, reserved as "paired slots" with partner engineer shadowing. Will need partner oncall windows.

paola: Ill run the curriculum sprint and assemble 3 micro-modules: (A) quick listing + CI stub, (B) hardware-aware perf tuning, (C) post-listing ops & rollback. Each module = 30-45m lab.

samir: Voucher automation on me. Plan: single-click voucher generate + short-lived creds TTL=8h. Also will produce an ops one-pager covering CIDR, KMS ARNs, and quota ticket template. Sample curl to mint a voucher (ops only):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/vouchers \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"label":"si-surge-wave1","count":10,"ttl":28800}'
```

partners-bot: Event created: "SI surge kickoff - wave 1" Mon 09:00 PT. Reminder set.

maya: Important constraints: ephemeral creds only, sandbox retention = 48h (logs snap, then purge), and explicit consent checkbox on enrollment. Badge policy: auto-issue for pass; manual revoke if partner violates listing policy.

paola: For labs, propose "pairing slots" where partner engineer sits in Zoom and can join the partner's CI run. We'll include a short runbook with steps: repo clone -> create listing -> deploy to sandbox -> perf check -> teardown.

jon: Ops checklist (mini): create slot, provision voucher, attach KMS role, ensure ECR write, open partner slack channel. I'll post a booking spreadsheet.

samir: Also adding a tiny health-check script partners can run post-deploy:
```
# health check
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rdx-small","input":"ping"}' | jq '.latency'
```
Expect p50 < 200ms on H100 baseline.

paola: Certification gate: quick quiz (10 Qs) + lab practical. Quick pass = badge; edge cases flagged for manual QA. Need two graders per wave. Volunteers? @samir can we have one ops reviewer, and @maya can coordinate partner QA?

samir: Can take ops reviewer slot for wave 1. Will also collect partner support windows (phone + slack) and paste here.

partners-bot: Note: partners confirmed - RackScale (H100) available weekdays 08:00-18:00 PT; CloudForge (Arm) evenings 18:00-23:00 PT. EdgeStack pending.

maya: Action items: Jon = slot booking spreadsheet + booking API (Thu EOD), Paola = curriculum draft + module slides (Fri), Samir = voucher automation + ops one-pager (Thu), Maya = partner contact escalation matrix + consent language (Fri). We'll run a 30-min preflight next Mon.

paola: Tiny ask: can we include a one-line "what not to do" list in the play (e.g., don't use prod keys, don't expose customer data)? I'll add the language.

jon: Also adding a quick rollback step for paired slots: revoke vouchers, snapshot logs, and notify partner oncall.

maya: Love it. This is a surge path so keep everything lightweight and repeatable. :rocket:
